integrity: Complete self-contained proof and reproducible finite exact checks; finite checks are diagnostic rather than an infinite proof. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the first inverse-image distribution at primitive positive Pythagorean angles under coordinatewise floor. The nonresonant density is pre-existing (Vladimirov, Theorem 19(d)); novelty is confined to rational resonance, odd numerator and a uniform square-root denominator estimate. Other quadrants, tie rules, higher iterates and optimal discrepancy constants are not established. Earlier equivalent formulas under quantizer-aliasing terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Arithmetic resonance and square-lattice discrepancy for digital planar rotations
